The '''2016–17 Xavier Musketeers men's basketball team''' represented [[Xavier University]] during the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. Led by eighth-year head coach [[Chris Mack (basketball)|Chris Mack]], they played their games at the [[Cintas Center]] in [[Norwood, Ohio]] and were fourth-year members of the [[Big East Conference]]. They finished the season 24–14, 9–9 in [[2016–17 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in seventh place. In the [[2017 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]], they defeated [[2016–17 DePaul Blue Demons men's basketball team|DePaul]] and [[2016–17 Butler Bulldogs men's basketball team|Butler]] before losing to [[2016–17 Creighton Bluejays men's basketball team|Creighton]] in the semifinals. They received an at-large bid to the [[2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as a No. 11 seed in the West region where they defeated [[2016–17 Maryland Terrapins men's basketball team|Maryland]], [[2016–17 Florida State Seminoles men's basketball team|Florida State]], and [[2016–17 Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team|Arizona]] before losing in the Elite Eight to [[2016–17 Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball team|Gonzaga]].

==Previous season==
The [[2015–16 Xavier Musketeers men's basketball team|Musketeers]] finished the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16 season]] 28–6, 14–4 in [[2015–16 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in second place. They defeated [[2015–16 Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball team|Marquette]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2016 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]] to advance to the semifinals where they lost to [[2015–16 Seton Hall Pirates men's basketball team|Seton Hall]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2016 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they received a No. 2 seed. They defeated [[2015–16 Weber State Wildcats men's basketball team|Weber State]] in the First Round to advance to the Second Round where they lost to [[2015–16 Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball team|Wisconsin]].

==Preseason==
